message.content: {"draft":"One program per row; vectorized load, FP32 max/exp/sum, masked store. Avoid persistent loop and extra host work to cut launch overhead on small shapes.","plan":"Grid=(n_rows,). BLOCK=next_pow2(cols). Load row, max, exp, sum, divide, store. No persistent loop, no num_stages arg, minimal host logic.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _softmax_kernel(","    input_ptr,","    output_ptr,","    n_cols,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","):","    row_idx = tl.program_id(0)","    col_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = col_offsets < n_cols","    row_ptrs = input_ptr + row_idx * n_cols + col_offsets","    row = tl.load(row_ptrs, mask=mask, other=-float('inf')).to(tl.float32)","    row_max = tl.max(row, axis=0)","    numerator = tl.exp(row - row_max)","    denominator = tl.sum(numerator, axis=0)","    result = numerator / denominator","    out_ptrs = output_ptr + row_idx * n_cols + col_offsets","    tl.store(out_ptrs, result, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    n_rows, n_cols = x.shape","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(n_cols)","    grid = (n_rows,)","    _softmax_kernel[grid](x, out, n_cols, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","    return out"]}
